evidence: A calculation on committed products: stage 2's water table re-solved on the atlas at 15 km, a generalized Vogel model of each cell's transit times through stage 1's permeability and porosity, unit-gradient drainage through the soil and the rock above the water table, and the recharge mixed along the steady flow; the carbonate system at each cell's ground temperature with the carbon cycle's constants, its catchment load in the soil water, Brook et al.'s soil CO2, field weathering rates that age as White & Brantley's and calcite at saturation. A runnable calculation checked against analytic solutions and the carbon cycle's solver. Its reaction rates, the rock's reactive surface and the pH at which the rock stops dissolving are Earth measurements and design guesses; no lunar groundwater has been measured.
reading_rule: Years from the moment the planned climate and the water are in place; the mature Moon is taken at a million years, when the deep crust has filled. Spring values are means over the springs' flow, the water mixed before it meets the air; saturation indices are of calcite once the water has come to the air's CO2, before any calcite comes out. Alkalinity in meq/kg, calcium and magnesium in mmol/kg, hardness as mg/L of CaCO3, CO2 in microatmospheres. Ages are the spread of times from rain to outflow at the springs: the median, and the shares younger than each age. Building shares are of the springs' flow and of the land where groundwater comes out. Deposits are the calcite the springs' water would lay after it meets the air, down to the tufa threshold or to saturation. Calcite laid is what comes out in the soil, the rock above the water table and the saturated rock a year, as carbon and as CaCO3.
